trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-stored 'homepage' path is a same-origin path safe to emit as a post-login Location target or an href; at the pinned commit decided only at write time by UserSetting::validate_homepage (leading '/' check), and never re-checked where the stored value is read and emitted.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'homepage' + 'open redirect'; the only server-side redirect that uses the homepage setting is routeafterlogin(), which redirects to $homepage['path'] verbatim, a few lines below the existing protocol-relative check for pre_login_requested_url.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /users/routeafterlogin (Auth->loginRedirect, app/Controller/AppController.php:146; also redirected to at app/Controller/UsersController.php:1656)
GET /users/routeafterlogin (pre_login_requested_url session value, written at app/Controller/AppController.php:442); refactor onto the shared validator, no behaviour change
GET /news/index when unread news exist; rendered as bare href at app/View/News/index.ctp:6
fix_sites.module_kind: controller of a neighbouring feature (news page link, not a redirect)

fix_sites.entry_point: every non-REST, non-AJAX HTML page render (beforeRender) -> menu logo/home links at app/View/Elements/global_menu.ctp:40, app/View/Elements/global_menu.ctp:639, app/View/Themed/UiBeta/Elements/global_menu.ctp:40, app/View/Themed/Overmind/Elements/navbar.ctp:3

POST /user_settings/setHomePage (app/Controller/UserSettingsController.php:514-538) and POST /user_settings/setSetting (app/Controller/UserSettingsController.php:196-232), both via UserSetting::setSetting validation at app/Model/UserSetting.php:668-677
new shared library InternalRedirectValidator::sanitize, plus read-time UserSetting::getHomepagePath (fix.diff:217-225)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Read side of the stored homepage row: app/Model/UserSetting.php:469-483 (getValueForUser, decoded in afterFind app/Model/UserSetting.php:267-275) consumed at app/Controller/AppController.php:501 and app/Controller/NewsController.php:40. The fix revalidates on read (fix.diff:204-225) because rows written before the store-time check, or via setSettingInternal() (app/Model/UserSetting.php:693-716, no validator), bypass validate_homepage.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Tightening validate_homepage (the store-time check) looks complete, since every live write route goes through setSetting(); the news 'Continue' link and the menu logo look like plain links (and the menu one is prefixed with $baseurl), not the redirect named in the advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate homepages must keep working: MISP named-parameter paths with colons (/events/index/searchtag:tlp:red), query+fragment, internal '//' later in the path, percent-encoded '%2f' left verbatim (not decoded); the menu star highlight compares the stored path to $this->here, so a fix that rewrites/normalises the stored path breaks it; default fallback to /events/index when unset.

O6_input_shapes: absolute scheme URLs http:, https:, javascript:
non-string path (array/int) and value as JSON string vs decoded array
percent-encoded '/%2f%2fhost' (session value decoded before validation; stored homepage not decoded)

O7_producer.where: app/Model/UserSetting.php:244-275 (beforeValidate json_encode / afterFind json_decode of the stored value); writer app/Model/UserSetting.php:693-716 setSettingInternal runs no setting validator

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a setHomePage variant (e.g. a theme-specific or 'reset to current page' action) persisting homepage via setSettingInternal() like setTheme does, skipping validate_homepage
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment at app/Controller/UserSettingsController.php:533-536 says the Overmind theme previously did exactly this; setTheme and setEventTemplateUserFormMode still use setSettingInternal.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a theme layout or controller that reads the homepage setting itself (getValueForUser) instead of the AppController-provided $homepage, e.g. for the Overmind/UiBeta logo or a dashboard 'home' button
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Three themes render the homepage link independently; a theme-specific controller fetching the setting directly is a natural shortcut.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second post-login path (e.g. the email_otp/totp completion or an SSO plugin return) that redirects to the stored homepage directly rather than via routeafterlogin
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _postlogin is called from several MFA flows (app/Controller/UsersController.php:1952, :2137); an auth plugin re-implementing the landing redirect is plausible.

O9_family: open redirect (CWE-601) via insufficient validation of a stored same-origin path (protocol-relative URL)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x, CakePHP 2.x via composer (app/Vendor not vendored for Cake core at pinned tree), PHPUnit
services: web server (Apache/nginx + php-fpm) for HTTP-level tests
O10_build.project_tests: Pure PHPUnit unit tests under app/Test/ (no Cake bootstrap, no DB), e.g. app/Test/DashboardURLValidatorTest.php, app/Test/UrlEgressValidatorTest.php; no existing test for homepage/routeafterlogin. The fix adds app/Test/InternalRedirectValidatorTest.php (absent at pinned commit).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a '//' / '/\' check to validate_homepage (store-time only) or only in routeafterlogin's homepage branch, leaving already-stored values and the news/menu href sinks unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: app/Lib/Dashboard/Tools/DashboardURLValidator.php:132-192 is a separate URL validator for dashboard widget links that allows protocol-relative URLs to allowed origins; different feature and policy, not pursued.
Many controllers redirect to $this->referer() (e.g. app/Controller/UserSettingsController.php:399); a Referer-driven redirect is a different trust input, not pursued.
UsersController::login redirects to $this->Auth->redirectUrl() (app/Controller/UsersController.php:1444); CakePHP core is not in the pinned tree, so its normalisation was not checked.
